siteUrlNote: Production base URL used for canonical, hreflang, Open Graph and sitemap. Change when a custom domain is chosen, then rebuild.
featuresNote: All monetization and communication services are OFF. 'analytics' and 'ads' are read by the build (Google tags are added only when enabled AND configured); the rest document state. Turning anything on requires a real provider, an updated privacy policy and explicit owner approval.

google.note: All null = nothing from Google is loaded. searchConsoleVerification: the content value of Google's HTML meta tag (not secret). ga4MeasurementId: G-XXXXXXX, used only when features.analytics is true, and loaded only after the visitor consents. adsensePublisherId: pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX, adds the AdSense verification meta tag and a root ads.txt. Ad scripts are NOT added automatically.
